name: StripForge
description: Stripboard (Veroboard) layout in KiCad: strip copper, cuts and wire links in a normal .kicad_pcb, KiCad DRC and a printable build sheet.
description_full:
StripForge turns a KiCad project's real footprints and netlist into stripboard copper on B.Cu at a 2.54 mm pitch. It snaps THT parts to the hole grid, splits the strips by net with real copper gaps plus cut markers, proposes wire links as zero-ohm jumpers that also live in the schematic, runs KiCad's DRC with schematic parity to catch shorts and opens, and writes a printable build sheet: the mirrored copper side with every cut, the component side, and checklists for cuts, slots, links, parts and a continuity check.

The PCB editor gets four toolbar actions: StripForge: Analyze, Build strips, Run DRC and Build sheet. Nothing edits the open board; Build strips writes <name>-stripforge.kicad_pcb next to it.

KiCad 10 IPC plugin (the IPC API must be enabled in Preferences > Plugins). Pre-alpha.
